settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.label: Rutile language
settings.header.tagline: Images, videos, apps, and sharing on a radial wheel · version {version}
settings.general.open.title: Open the wheel
settings.general.open.note: In the wheel, ← and → select a slice and Return opens it; the numbers 1 to 9 (0 for the tenth) open one directly. ↑ and ↓ switch wheels, and Esc closes it.
settings.general.shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
settings.general.shortcut.hintMac: If another app already uses this shortcut, macOS gives it priority.
settings.general.shortcut.hintOther: Pressing it again closes the wheel.
settings.general.shortcut.wayland: On Wayland, apps can’t listen to the keyboard. Bind the command {command} to a system keyboard shortcut: Settings → Keyboard → Custom Shortcuts.
settings.general.shake.title: Shake a file
settings.general.shake.label: Open the wheel by shaking a dragged file
settings.general.shake.hintWayland: Requires membership in the “input” group, which also gives access to the keyboard.
settings.general.shake.hint: A few quick back-and-forth moves while dragging.
settings.general.startup.title: Startup
settings.general.startup.label: Open Rutile at login
settings.general.permissions.title: Permissions
settings.general.permissions.finderHint: To convert or share the selected file when the wheel opens.
settings.wheels.title: Wheels
settings.wheels.note: Clicking the center (or pressing ↓) switches to the next wheel, in this order. Drag a row by its handle to move it.
settings.wheels.customEmpty: Custom wheel · empty, so it doesn’t appear yet
settings.wheels.dwell.label: Hold time
settings.wheels.dwell.hint: In the center while dragging, to switch between converting and sharing, or on a slice of the Actions wheel to open its options.
settings.wheels.remember.label: Reopen on the last wheel used
settings.wheels.remember.on: The wheel comes back to where you left off.
settings.wheels.remember.off: Otherwise, the wheel opens on the first one in the list.
settings.wheels.fileWheel.label: Wheel opened by a file
settings.wheels.switch.on: Order and other wheels are in the Wheels tab.
settings.wheels.switch.off: Turned off: it doesn’t appear when you click the center.
settings.conversion.quality.title: Quality of lossy formats
settings.conversion.quality.note: The higher the quality, the larger the file.
settings.conversion.vector.title: Vectorization
settings.conversion.vector.note: Only SVG output is vectorized: the image is retraced as shapes in solid colors, sharp at any size. This is ideal for a logo or an icon, but approximate for a photo. PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, and ICO keep their pixels, and an SVG converted to them is first rendered as pixels.
settings.conversion.videos.title: Videos
settings.conversion.videos.available: Converts videos from the Video wheel.
settings.colors.parts.title: Slice colors
settings.colors.parts.click: Click a slice of the wheel, or its center, then choose its color below.
settings.colors.hint.highlight: The slice under the pointer, and the ring around the targeted button.
settings.colors.hint.icon: An app, a folder, or a website keeps its icon.
settings.colors.hint.custom: This slice, on this wheel only.
settings.colors.hint.customWithOptions: This slice, on this wheel only; its options inherit it.
settings.colors.hint.actions: The slice, and the actions of its sub-wheel.
settings.colors.hint.format: This format’s badge, on all wheels.
settings.colors.material.title: Material
settings.colors.glass.hintNative: macOS glass: it refracts and reflects what’s behind the wheel.
settings.colors.glass.hintFake: An imitation: real glass is only available on macOS 26 or later.
settings.colors.border.label: Wheel outline
settings.colors.highlight.title: Highlight
settings.colors.highlight.hoveredHint: Lit-up sector and ring around the targeted button.
settings.colors.original.label: Original colors
settings.colors.original.hint: Button text stays legible: white or dark depending on the color.
settings.actions.root.title: Actions wheel
settings.actions.root.note: Drag a slice by its handle to move it: the first is at the top of the wheel, the rest follow clockwise. Hold on a slice for a second to open its options; the center goes back to the previous wheel, like Esc.
settings.actions.files.title: By file type
settings.actions.files.note: A file that’s shaken, dragged onto the wheel, or selected in {manager} opens the wheel you choose. Its Actions wheel shows only these actions, in this order, and only those that make sense (merging needs at least two PDFs); ten at most. Several mixed types count as “Others.”
settings.actions.files.opensOnOff: This wheel is turned off: the first one in the list opens instead.
settings.actions.files.opensOnHint: The wheel shown when a file of this type arrives.
settings.actions.capture.title: Capture
settings.actions.capture.reopen: Reopen the wheel after a capture
settings.actions.capture.reopenHint: To convert or share the image right away.
settings.actions.capture.readHint: macOS asks for Screen Recording permission, which has to be granted again after an update.
settings.actions.capture.arrangeHint: Moving another app’s window requires Accessibility permission.
settings.apps.wheel.title: Apps wheel
settings.apps.title: Apps
settings.apps.note: Clicking a slice opens the app, folder, or website; a file dropped on an app opens with it. The wheel holds {min} to {max} slices.
settings.apps.noteMac: Clicking a slice opens the app, folder, or website; a file dropped on an app opens with it. The wheel holds {min} to {max} slices. Dock notification badges appear on the icons.
settings.apps.badges.title: Notification badges
settings.apps.badges.label: Badges for closed apps
settings.apps.badges.hint: Messages and Mail keep theirs in the Dock after closing; Rutile reads them there with Accessibility permission.
settings.share.wheel.title: Share wheel
settings.share.title: Destinations
settings.share.noteMac: “Share…” opens the macOS share menu: choose the app, then the recipient. AirDrop, Messages, and Mail open their sending window directly. A synced folder (Google Drive, iCloud Drive…) receives a copy, which its app uploads. For Signal and messaging apps without sharing, the file is copied and then the app opens: paste it with {paste} into the conversation.
settings.share.note: A synced folder (Google Drive, iCloud Drive…) receives a copy, which its app uploads. For Signal and messaging apps without sharing, the file is copied and then the app opens: paste it with {paste} into the conversation.
settings.share.sheet.title: Destination · {position}
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.autoHint: At launch, then every six hours; Rutile asks before installing.
settings.custom.intro.title: Build your wheel
settings.custom.intro.text: Apps, folders, websites, conversions, actions: put whatever you want on a single wheel. It then takes its place among the others when you click the center.
settings.custom.gallery.title: My Wheels · {count}
settings.custom.gallery.note: Open a wheel to build it. Their order, when you click the center, is set in the Wheels tab.
settings.custom.noteEmpty: While it’s empty, the wheel doesn’t appear among the others.
settings.custom.note: Drag a slice by its handle to move it: the first is at the top of the wheel, the rest follow clockwise. Ten slices at most; their colors are set in the Colors tab.
settings.custom.previewHint: Here’s your wheel. Click a slice to change it.
settings.custom.name: Wheel name
settings.custom.display.title: Display
settings.custom.display.showHint: Its place among the others is set in the Wheels tab.
settings.custom.extensions.label: Only for certain files
settings.custom.extensions.limited: It only appears if all the files have one of these extensions.
settings.custom.extensions.always: Leave empty for it to always appear.
settings.picker.shortcut.placeholder: As named in the Shortcuts app
settings.picker.shortcut.hint: The wheel’s files are passed to it as input.
settings.picker.command.hint: The wheel’s files are its arguments: $1, $2…
settings.picker.name: Name
settings.picker.site.noLogo: This site doesn’t provide a logo: it will keep the globe.
settings.picker.site.hint: The logo and name come from the site itself.
settings.picker.formats.hint: The slice converts the wheel’s files, or asks you to choose some if there are none.
